messages:
maya: heads-up — canary v3.2.1 scheduled for 10:30 PT, but QA flagged a change-window conflict with backup job window. can we shift or hold?
liam: got it. which backup job?
maya: nightly-snapshot-run, starts 10:20 PT and runs ~15m. overlap risk for our DB migrations during canary.
tasha: ugh — ops prefers no migration during snapshots. canary includes a small tokenizer migration.
raul: what if we delay 20m to 10:50? still safe for the schedule and keeps cutover tonight.
maya: delay ok w/ me, but we need deploybot to re-schedule the staged rollout and update release notes and notify customer success.
deploy-bot: @channel canary rollout scheduled: model-service v3.2.1 -> starting 2026-03-23T17:30:54Z (10:30 PT). To reschedule, run `/deploy reschedule 3235987654 --start 2026-03-23T17:50:00Z`
liam: running the reschedule now. `/deploy reschedule 3235987654 --start 2026-03-23T17:50:00Z`
deploy-bot: Request received. Updating rollout start time to 2026-03-23T17:50:00Z. Canary config remains: 2 nodes, 5% traffic, K/V cache warmed.
ops-bot: Ops note: nightly-snapshot-run confirmed for 10:20-10:35 PT. No conflicts with new 10:50 start.
tasha: thumbs up from infra. can we pin rollback thresholds? last time we lacked a clear metric for KB token regressions.
raul: propose triggers: >1.5x p95 latency, >2% error rate delta, or embedding mismatch score >0.08 on control set => auto-pause + notify.
sre-oncall: add an alert for KV cache memory growth >15% over baseline during canary — that was an issue before.
liam: added thresholds to canary config and set `auto_pause=true` in rollout policy.
maya: release notes: add migration note and rollback criteria. small consumer-facing change: tokenization id bump. cc @product.
liam: creating PR for release-notes: `docs/release-notes/v3.2.1.md` with migration steps. will link in the deploy thread.
raul: should we inform a subset of enterprise customers? suggest CS outreach to customers with scheduled jobs in same window.
tasha: I'll ping CS to call out the 10:50 start and migration.
maya: final check — any objections to go at 10:50?
liam: none from me.
sre-oncall: I'll be watching telemetry during the first 20m.
maya: ok let's proceed. reschedule confirmed. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary start updated. New start: 2026-03-23T17:50:00Z. Notifying participants: maya, liam, tasha, raul, sre-oncall.
liam: postmortem note: if we hit KV growth, rollback_to v3.2.0 is scripted as `deploy rollback 3235987654 --to v3.2.0` — keep that handy.
raul: noted. I'll stash the rollback command in the ops runbook.
maya: thanks team. I'll close out once CS confirms notifications sent. :pray:
ops-bot: CS notified: message queued to 7 enterprise accounts with potential schedule overlap.
maya: closing thread — will reopen if any signal.
